title: Normal operating current
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the current from rated power and voltage, yielding 0.3 A.

title: Mechanical power derivation
description: Important: Applies Joule's law to find resistive heating and subtracts it from rated power to find mechanical output.

title: Stall current calculation
description: Essential: Correctly applies Ohm's law when the fan stalls, using total resistance to find 110 A.

title: Stall power calculation
description: Important: Calculates the actual power consumed during a stall using the formula for a pure resistor.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains correct units (A, W, Ω, V) throughout all calculations.

title: Confusing power types
description: Pitfall: Mistakenly uses rated power as the mechanical power or misidentifies the power relationship in normal operation.

title: Ohmic stall error
description: Pitfall: Uses the normal operating current instead of Ohm's law to find the stall current.
